relations.product: joint venture Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation (Koshi City, Kumamoto, Japan) for development and volume manufacturing of smartphone image sensors, using TSMC's advanced process technology and manufacturing expertise
relations.quote: Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation (“Sony”) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (“TSMC”) (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) today announced the execution of a legally binding definitive agreement for the establishment of Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation as a joint venture (“JV”) in Koshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.
relations.label: TSMC press release: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC Agreed to Establish (08-11-2026)

relations.product: IC foundry capacity at SSMC in Singapore under the shareholders' capacity purchase commitment
relations.quote: TSMC and NXP B.V. currently own approximately 39% and 61% of the SSMC shares, respectively. TSMC and NXP B.V. are required, in the aggregate, to purchase at least 70% of SSMC’s capacity, but TSMC alone is not required to purchase more than 28% of the capacity.
relations.label: TSMC 6-K (08-14-2026)
relations.figure: TSMC and NXP B.V. together at least 70% of SSMC's capacity; TSMC alone not required to purchase more than 28%
